dataset: Live UK postcode -> WGS84 coordinate lookup, one file per postcode area
note_fields: Latitude/longitude taken directly from ONSPD lat/long (WGS84); ONSPD eastings/northings were NOT used or converted.
filter: doterm field empty = live only; terminated postcodes excluded
precision_note: 4 decimal places (~11 m). Users drag the marker to its final position, so metre-level precision is unnecessary.
key_format: full postcode with a single space, e.g. "NP16 5AB" (matches how the app stores postcodes)
structure: per-area file = { area, count, ..., postcodes: { "<POSTCODE>": [lat, lng], ... } }
coverage: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland (BT). Crown Dependencies (GY Guernsey, IM Isle of Man, JE Jersey) are present in ONSPD but EXCLUDED, matching the rest of v6 (no boundary geometry, not in areas-index).
bt_note: BT (Northern Ireland) has coordinates but no boundary geometry in v6, as the geography files record.
